proof_scope: real skill/alias files are checked by the Pi-extension standard validator; adversarial temp copies remove required clauses to prove the gate fails closed

claims.proves: the Pi-extension standard cites official Pi docs, Brave-search evidence, Nico Bailon extension patterns, TypeBox tool schemas, lifecycle cleanup, output guarding, deterministic report guards, and executable eval posture
claims.does_not_prove: that any future Pi extension is correct, safe, loaded in a live Pi session, or human-accepted; each extension still needs its own load/effect readback

capability_claims.description: the standard is grounded in official Pi docs, Brave-search receipts, and installed Nico extension implementations
the standard requires executable agentic eval fixtures and fails when eval posture is removed
the singular/typo alias routes to the canonical plural standard and carries its own eval posture

failure_modes: agentic-evals is documented but no fixture exists

cases.name: missing-agentic-evals-is-rejected
command:
T=$(mktemp -d); cp -R .. "$T/skill"; python3 - "$T/skill/SKILL.md" "$T/skill/README.md" "$T/skill/PROJECT_KNOWLEDGE.md" "$T/skill/fixtures/agentic_eval.json" <<'PY'
import pathlib, sys
for raw in sys.argv[1:]:
    p = pathlib.Path(raw)
    text = p.read_text()
    text = text.replace('agentic-evals', 'agentic evals removed')
    text = text.replace('agentic_eval.json', 'eval_removed.json')
    p.write_text(text)
PY
python3 "$T/skill/scripts/check_pi_extension_standard.py" --skill-dir "$T/skill" --skip-nico; rc=$?; rm -rf "$T"; exit $rc

cases.name: missing-nico-source-grounding-is-rejected
command:
T=$(mktemp -d); cp -R .. "$T/skill"; python3 - "$T/skill/SKILL.md" "$T/skill/README.md" "$T/skill/PROJECT_KNOWLEDGE.md" <<'PY'
import pathlib, sys
for raw in sys.argv[1:]:
    p = pathlib.Path(raw)
    text = p.read_text()
    text = text.replace('pi-mcp-adapter', 'pi-mcp-example-removed')
    text = text.replace('github.com/nicobailon', 'github.com/example-removed')
    p.write_text(text)
PY
python3 "$T/skill/scripts/check_pi_extension_standard.py" --skill-dir "$T/skill" --skip-nico; rc=$?; rm -rf "$T"; exit $rc
